results.question_text: Reference: SLP1 - RFI0893.2 - B1 Balcony Guardrail Added Plate to Embeds Confirmation_R2 SLP1 - RFI0893.1 - B1 Balcony Guardrail Added Plate to Embeds Confirmation_R1 RFI0893.1-SK5, and SK6 Post on: Detail 8/A8.21 Background: Due to missed steel embeds at corners of Level 3 balcony curbs, the steel embeds for the balcony guardrail were set 1' off of correct locations at the SW and SE balconies. To provide an alternative means of attachment for the balcony guardrails where steel embeds are missing, we propose adding steel plates connected to the steel embeds as noted in the attached sketches. Structural confirmation for the proposed remedial solution was confirmed by Jonathan Chen of DES per response to RFI 0893.1. However, after further evaluation of the originally proposed solution it was determined that a new solution was required due to the limited space between the coping cap from the metal panel and the face of the curb. After reviewing the various options that were discussed, it was decided that the most effective solution would be to add a L5x5 angle where the 1 ½” plate cantilevers, next to the L6x7 angle that will get anchored to the side of the curb. This L5x5 would get anchored down to the SOMD and welded to the bottom of the cantilevered plate. This would occur only at the ends of the curbs where the plate is cantilevered. At the corner’s where we have a column concrete curb, we are proposing to use L5x5 angles to omit the anchor bolts at each plate. The top of the L5x5 would get welded to the bottom of the 1 ½” to provide the support needed. These angles would then get anchored down to the existing column concrete curb. Question: Q1. Please review and confirm the revised proposed sketches SK5 and SK6 (showing the addition of the steel plate per RFI 0893 and omitting the anchors) are acceptable per the attached email with Jonathan Chen/DES.
